arguments.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN q.q2 GLOB '[0-9]:[0-5][0-9].[0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN 'm:ss.mmm' ELSE quote(q.q2) END AS time_format, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_rows, COUNT(d.driverId) AS driver_matches, MIN(q.q2) AS first_value, MAX(q.q2) AS last_value
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
LEFT JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
GROUP BY time_format

arguments.sql:
WITH season_q2 AS (
    SELECT q.driverId, r.name AS race_name, q.q2
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017 AND q.q2 <> ''
)
SELECT d.surname, s.race_name
FROM season_q2 AS s
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = s.driverId
WHERE s.q2 = (SELECT MIN(q2) FROM season_q2)
ORDER BY d.surname, s.race_name
